name: Gryan Stoutmantle
summary: At Sentinel Hill in Westfall, Gryan Stoutmantle leads the People's Militia. A paladin of the Silver Hand, he came home from Lordaeron to defend his birthplace after Stormwind's crown left it to banditry.

sections.title: A Knight Returned Home
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle first served far from Westfall. As a young man, he traveled north to Lordaeron and took vows as a Knight of the Silver Hand. He endured the horrors of the Third War there. Then word reached him that his native province was falling into lawlessness, overrun by organized brigands and abandoned by the crown. Gryan left the northern fronts to defend honest farmers, resolved that Westfall would not fall as the north had.

sections.title: The People's Militia
sections.body:
When Gryan returned, Westfall had almost no defenders. Royal neglect and political paralysis in the House of Nobles kept Stormwind from sending garrison troops. So Gryan formed the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill, gathering local farmers, sentries, and traveling mercenaries into a volunteer defense corps.

The militia holds a precarious line against the Defias Brotherhood, riverpaw gnolls, and hostile mechanoids. Even when nearby Lakeshire pleads for aid, Gryan cannot spare reinforcements.

sections.title: Unmasking the Kingpin
sections.body:
Gryan Stoutmantle sought to learn who directed Westfall's ruin. He called in an old debt from Wiley the Black, a rogue in Redridge, and spoke with Mathias Shaw of SI:7. Their intelligence revealed that Edwin VanCleef led the bandits. VanCleef was the slighted master architect of the Stonemasons' Guild.

After the militia captured a bandit trying to plunder a local wagon, Gryan used the prisoner to find the Brotherhood's headquarters beneath Moonbrook, within the Deadmines. He sent veteran champions to strike VanCleef directly.

faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle leads the People's Militia from its headquarters at Sentinel Hill. He is a paladin of the Silver Hand.

faq.q: Why is the People's Militia needed if Westfall belongs to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's House of Nobles refused to send crown soldiers or treasury funds to protect Westfall. Left alone against marauders and gnolls, local farmers formed their own defense force under Gryan's leadership.

faq.q: What is Gryan's history with the Silver Hand?
faq.answer: As a young man, Gryan traveled to Lordaeron and became a paladin of the Silver Hand. He served on northern battlefields during the Third War, then left to defend his imperiled homeland.

faq.q: Why does Gryan refuse to send aid to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Gryan had to refuse Magistrate Solomon's request for reinforcements against Redridge's gnolls and orcs. The People's Militia is stretched thin defending Sentinel Hill, and Gryan fears even a small detachment would leave Westfall to the Defias.

faq.q: How did Gryan discover where the Defias were hiding?
faq.answer: Gryan sought intelligence from Wiley the Black and Mathias Shaw, then sent adventurers to investigate the Brotherhood. What they uncovered is told in a hidden passage.

faq.q: Who is Wiley the Black to Gryan?
faq.answer: Wiley the Black lives at the inn in Lakeshire and owes his life to Gryan. Gryan has little affection for the rogue's unsavory nature, but used that debt to gain intelligence on Defias operations.

angles.text: As a paladin, Gryan shows the Silver Hand's duty by bringing the Light's protection to Westfall's farmers when the church and crown ignore the poor.
As an Alliance member, you can see Stormwind's political inaction leave loyal citizens to arm themselves and defend the heartland.
As a human, you share Gryan's roots in Westfall and the resilience of Stormwind's rural folk, who face brigands and neglect from the capital.
